neighbours.label: Deception by false front: text about something made to look legitimate or normal while it is fake (fake threats, aliases to be perceived, mimicking normal people), vs the same subjects described honestly
fire: The scareware pops up warnings and reports hundreds of fake infections to frighten users.
Con artists are aware of how they come across and copy the manners of honest people.
Some users adopt fake personas in order to be seen as experts in the forum.
The shell firm was set up only to appear like a real business to the bank.
The phishing page displays a fake login form that mimics the bank's real site.
Sociopaths are skilled at hiding their coldness and imitating ordinary warmth.
The rogue app shows fake virus alerts to pressure people into paying.
He created several fake accounts to be perceived as more popular than he was.
quiet: The security software shows warnings and reports real infections to users.
Teachers are aware of how they come across and try to speak clearly.
Some users list their degrees in order to show their background in the forum.
The new firm was set up to sell office chairs to local businesses.
The bank's page displays a login form that loads quickly on phones.
Nurses are skilled at calming patients before an operation.
The weather app shows rain alerts so people can plan their day.
He created several playlists to share with his friends at the party.

predictions: Pretense sentences reach 0.2-0.5; honest versions stay under 0.06.
notes: Probe: fake antivirus 'reports' 0.47, psychopaths 'conscious of' 0.39, aliases 'perceived' 0.28, legitimate-company scam 0.13, invented brother 0.10; honest versions 0.02-0.05. Peak token varies.
